purpose: Runtime atlases based on approved designs, flatter chunky pixel style

jobs.prompt: Production game sprite atlas. VERY FLAT LOW RESOLUTION CHUNKY PIXEL ART, clean rectangular pixel clusters, no gradients no lighting effects no noise no texture dithering, only 2 flat tones per material, consistent dark 1-pixel-equivalent outline. Cute fantasy goblin game. Orthographic front view with a small top view, NOT isometric. Transparent background, no ground shadows, no labels no numbers no grid lines. Exact regular grid occupying entire canvas with equal cells, all sprites centered inside cells with transparent padding and consistent bottom baseline. Every sprite must stay entirely inside its own cell. Sprite detail should look as if drawn at 32x32 (units) or 48x48 (buildings) then nearest-neighbor enlarged. Create exactly 40 building sprites, canvas 1536x960, EXACTLY EIGHT COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 192x192 cells. Columns left to right: purple-roof goblin castle, gold mine, purple mushroom farm, red melee barracks tent, green archer barracks tent, purple elite barracks, wooden/stone wall segment, goblin arrow tower. Rows top to bottom are levels 1,2,3,4,5. Same type remains recognizable, each level visibly changes: simple wood; reinforced wood; grey stone foundation; stronger stone and purple banners; majestic gold trim and crown flags. Castle simple hut grows into multi-tower fortress, walls wooden stakes to stone battlements, towers single platform to armored tower. Keep all sprites usable as centered game art, no background. Flatten the attached concept style and greatly simplify small details.
